name: Frigidaire® 30" 18.6 Cu. Ft. White Garage Ready Top Freezer Refrigerator
shortDescription: This Frigidaire 19 Cu. Ft. top freezer refrigerator includes spacious interior storage options designed for busy families, including generous door bins, adjustable full-width glass shelving, and a sliding deli drawer. Our humidity-controlled crispers keep produce fresh for longer, allowing you to waste less and save money.

features.text: Humidity-Controlled Crisper Drawers
Keep produce fresher longer, so you waste less and save money with our humidity-controlled crisper drawers with roller support.
Spacious Interior Storage
Find a place for everything with our spacious interior storage solutions designed for busy families including generous door bins and a full-width glass freezer shelf.
Large Door Bins
Our large bins offer more door storage and organization, without sacrificing valuable shelf space.
ENERGY STAR®
Recognized as an ENERGY STAR® certified product.
Garage Ready
Place this unit in your garage without worry. This unit is designed to perform in temperatures ranging from 44°F to 110°F.
Deli Drawer
Keep sandwich meats and cheeses organized and easy to reach in a convenient dedicated drawer.
EvenTemp™ Cooling System
Prevent warm spots and unwanted freezing with our cooling system that optimizes airflow to ensure a consistent temperature throughout your refrigerator.
Ice Maker Ready
Enjoy the flexibility of later adding an ice maker without sacrificing valuable freezer space thanks to our optional slim ice maker.
Bright LED Lighting
Easily see what is inside with our enhanced LED lighting.
Reversible Doors
Doors can be installed to open left or right based on your needs.
Integrated Handle Design
Seamless design provides a clean exterior look.
